objective: Re-review existing prediction-market exploit candidates under the policy that any evidence-compatible net EV > 0 remains research-eligible regardless of current daily scale, and formalize persistent WATCH/resurrection triggers so later material news or regime changes can reopen blocked or currently unattractive routes without erasing prior negative evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Existing promising and previously scale-deprioritized routes are explicitly re-reviewed under the positive-EV admission rule.
WATCH is defined as a persistent nonterminal monitoring state, not a rejection or proof of edge.
Each WATCH item can carry concrete recheck triggers tied to rules, fees, access, source semantics, settlement, liquidity/depth, executable pricing, new datasets/holdouts, or new mechanism evidence.
Material trigger evidence causes re-evaluation, not automatic promotion.
Prior negative evidence remains attached and cannot be erased by resurrection.
Scheduled research checks WATCH triggers without wasting full research cycles on unchanged items.
No live trading, paid action, wallet action, or proof-standard weakening is introduced.
non_goals: Promote any candidate to PROVEN_EDGE without evidence.
Authorize live trading or capital use.
Blindly rerun every historical negative every hour without a material trigger.
independent_verification: Verify the methodology, machine-readable worker contract, candidate schema and WATCH registry agree on positive-EV admission, persistent WATCH semantics, trigger-based resurrection and preservation of negative evidence.
rollback_plan: Revert only these governance/research-state changes if contradictions are found; preserve the charter and audit trail.
cleanup_plan: No temporary runtime resources are created.
